metadata.title: धूप में तपते हैं तब मिलते हैं ये गहने | Silver Jewellery of Bhil Women
metadata.description:
In this episode of Main Bhi Bharat, we take you to Khargone district of Madhya Pradesh. Here you will meet women of Barela tribe, and learn about their costumes and jewellery. These women have a fascination for silver jewellery and buy it by the kilo. This tribe also pays bride price in silver only.

#Tribal_Jewellery #Silver_Jewellery #Madhya_Pradesh
